newsitem.title: USA: Titan sees meeting Q2 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Titan sees meeting Q2 EPS view.

text.p: Titan International Inc said Wednesday it is expects to meet analysts' consensus earnings per share expectations for the second quarter of $0.35 to $0.37 per share fully diluted.

In a statement, Titan also said it anticipates record net sales for the second quarter of 1997. Overall market strength during the quarter ended June 30, the company said, led it to expect record sales compared with the year-ago quarter, when net sales totaled $167 million.
Final results for second quarter will be announced on July 17, it added.

"Second quarter has brought many exciting developments for Titan," Maurice Taylor Jr, president, said in a statement. "Our new Grizz LSW series of wheel and tire assemblies has grabbed the attention of the off-highway tire industry."

The Grizz LSW line begins in the fourth quarter of 1997, with a new wheel and tire size to be introduced every 90 days thereafter, Taylor said. "We anticipate that these positive events will be beneficial to our shareholders."
Titan is a global manufacturer of mounted tire and wheel systems for off-highway equipment.
